purpose: P0-04 rendering refinement. User prefers Petrol & Coral colors and rejects pixel-art-like appearance. Smooth stylized 3D is a new review candidate, not an approved final style.

concepts.reference_role: Right Petrol & Coral panel supplies palette and ordinary urban composition; rendering style is changed.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: P0-04 revised original top-down 3D arcade city gameplay-camera concept.
Input image: reference board. Use ONLY the RIGHT panel, PETROL & CORAL, as the reference for palette and everyday city setting. The left violet panel is irrelevant. Output ONE full-width scene, not a split board.
Primary request: Reimagine the petrol/coral street corner as a CLEAN, POLISHED, SMOOTH STYLIZED 3D GAME RENDER. Remove the previous image's pixel-art-like appearance, gritty texture noise, dense tiny details and sprite-like characters. Retain rich deep petrol blue/teal bases, emerald roofs, vivid coral/orange accents, cobalt details and warm amber vehicles. Clean sculptural three-dimensional shapes with rounded bevels, broad smoothly shaded surfaces, appealing smooth molded painted materials, crisp anti-aliased contours and restrained soft contact shadows. No noisy or gritty surface texture, pixelated texture, dithering, mosaic shading, voxels, outlined pixel sprites, retro aesthetics, handpainted scratches, photorealistic weathering, realistic clutter or visible low-poly facets. Smooth gradients and subtle roughness variation convey materials. Simple geometry with depth, not flat vector art.
Camera: exactly 90-degree VERTICAL NADIR top-down orthographic view; optical axis points straight down. Roads exactly vertical/horizontal. Only rooftops, car tops and top views of people's heads/shoulders are visible. No exposed vertical building facades, no isometric angle, no horizon, no perspective taper, no tilted render. Shape shading and short shadows convey 3D depth even from directly overhead. Wide gameplay frame, ideally 1280x800 proportion, no text, no swatch strip, no border, no HUD.
Composition: an ordinary four-way road intersection at centre with continuous generous sidewalks and clean white crossing marks. Upper left: one low-rise everyday shop with a broad emerald-teal roof and coral awning. Upper right: uncluttered small plaza with simple circular teal water-tower cap, two broad planters and one bench. Lower left: workshop with only three broad smooth sawtooth roof folds, petrol/teal colors. Lower right: clean small car repair yard with one parked cobalt sedan, one broad coral canopy, and a few large props placed along the edge. Remove rooftop vents/pipes/cables, dense tire piles, crates and tiny debris. Normal masonry/concrete city, no futuristic buildings or cyberpunk megacity infrastructure.
Cars: one rounded compact coral hatchback on lower road and one long chunky amber sedan on upper road, clearly different smooth 3D roof/bonnet/trunk silhouettes, clean painted bodywork, glossy but subtle broad highlights, opaque dark blue-gray windows, no modeled occupants. People: one readable player on right sidewalk in warm ivory/coral jacket, broad chunky shoulders, head and arms visible from above, three spare smooth stylized pedestrians in contrasting colored clothing. Favor readable slightly exaggerated silhouettes over tiny realistic people; no separate character portraits. Crisp dark blue-teal road surface with smooth low-frequency shading; sidewalks a middle-value cool slate, clearly brighter than roads. Rich dark colors must still have visible detail.
Lighting: fixed dry daytime, rich saturated materials, gentle ambient fill, short soft-edged cast shadows, controlled highlights. Contrast and smooth material shading supply richness. Cyberpunk influence is ONLY the vibrant palette. Avoid neon outlines, extensive emissive trim, wet surfaces, rain, night scene, bloom, fog, depth of field, tilt shift, film grain or cinematic grading that obscures roads.
This is original conceptual 3D reference art, not a real engine screenshot. Preserve the selected petrol/coral color family while changing the rendering style dramatically toward clean modern stylized 3D.
